scenarios.scenario: Select and clears multiple recent-document rows

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are displayed in List View
one recent-document row is checked and no other rows are checked
the user checks a second recent-document row
both rows are checked and highlighted
Open Selected and Remove Selected appear above the list
the user clears the second row's checkbox
the first row remains checked
the selected-item actions remain visible
the user clears the first row's checkbox
no recent-document rows are checked
Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed above the list

scenarios.scenario: Pin and unpin a recent document card

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
an unpinned recent part is displayed in Grid View
the user hovers over the part's card
a Pin control appears on the card
the user activates Pin
the control offers Unpin
the part remains in the recent grid
the user activates Unpin
the control offers Pin again
the part remains in the recent grid

scenarios.scenario: Hide, restore and reorder a recent-document column

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are in List View
Location is displayed immediately after Name
the user opens Column Settings and clears Location
the Location header and values disappear from the list
Location is unchecked in Available Columns
the user selects Location again
Location appears after the other adjustable columns
the user drags Location above Date Modified in Displayed Columns
Location appears immediately after Name in the list
the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
the user searches for "Part26", clears the field and activates Search to restore the broader list
the recent search history contains "Part26"
a recent part named "Part26" is the only visible document matching that term
the search field is empty and the broader recent list is displayed
the user focuses Search recent
the user chooses "Part26" from Search History
the search field contains "Part26"
the recent list displays the matching part
the other previously visible documents are not displayed

scenarios.scenario: Select and clears recent rows using the header checkbox

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
several recent documents are displayed in List View
no recent-document rows are checked
the user checks the list header checkbox
all visible recent-document rows are checked and highlighted
Open Selected and Remove Selected appear above the list
the user clears one visible row's checkbox
that row is unchecked while the other visible rows remain checked
the header checkbox shows a partial selection
the user activates the partially selected header checkbox
all visible recent-document rows are checked again
the user clears the header checkbox
the visible recent-document rows are unchecked
Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed above the list

scenarios.scenario: Sort recent rows by name and carry the order into Grid View

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents with different names are displayed in List View
Last Opened is the active descending sort
the user selects the Name column header
the visible rows are ordered by name in descending order
a downward sort indicator appears in the Name header
the user selects the Name column header again
the visible rows are ordered by name in ascending order
the Name header shows an upward sort indicator
the user switches to Grid View
Sort by shows Name with an upward direction indicator
the visible cards follow the ascending name order
